source.author: stat
source.text: illum sed taceo: prohibet tranquilla senectus, iamque ego vos avide subicit Phoebeia Manto:
source.text_original: illum — sed taceo: prohibet tranquilla senectus, / iamque ego vos' — avide subicit Phoebeia Manto: /
source.text_english: But I pass over him in silence; tranquil old age forbids it, and now Phoebeian Manto eagerly brings you under my control:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illumetu tantum non indignantibus undis hoc caput accipias et pressam regibus alnum.
reuse.text_original: †illumetu tantum / non indignantibus undis / hoc caput accipias et pressam regibus alnum.
reuse.text_english: may you receive this head, the waves almost not indignant, and the alder-tree, pressed down by kings.
